coordinateConvention: pixel dimensions after alpha trim; origin top-left; anchor is foot-ground center

enemyProof.telegraph: separate magenta ring and filled radius; color-independent circular silhouette is not yet approved

limitations: Every character state is a single independently generated pose, not a sequence or animation atlas.
Idle movement and foot timing are currently interpolated procedurally; there is no generated locomotion loop.
Punch is one right-authored image pose and is not a directional punch sequence; it is not mirrored.
Dodge is one right-authored pose; hitbox/pose alignment is visual approximation only.
Ember Drive image is a brief visual cue; current mechanics remain the prototype damage modifier.
Frame bounds, feet anchors and silhouettes were checked by visual inspection only; automated hitbox, per-frame and alpha-edge validation is not implemented.
